Selection of Awardees -The parameters to be used in selecting the
Presidential A wardees shall be determined by the National Technical Working Group
organized by the Council for the Welfare of Children.

.

FreQuency of Award -The Search shall be an annual award to be
spearheaded
by the Council for the Welfare of the Children (CWC).

Awards and Prizes -The Presidential Award shall be conferred on each
national awardee as indicated in Section I hereof, through the local chief executive
concerned in the form of a Presidential trophy, citation and a cash prize of not less than
One Hundred Fifty Thousand Pesos (PI 50,000.00) to be utilized for projects for children,
to be sourced from the President's Fund.
Likewise, each national nominee for the four (4) categories shall be conferred a
Presidential Plaque of Commendation.

Recordine: and Evaluation -The National Historical Institute (Nlll) of
the Presidential Commission for Culture and Arts shall evaluate the design of the
Presidential trophy and citation as to precedence, design, customs and traditiol)s and shall
recommend final approval of the Office of the President. The approved design shall be
returned to the NHI for proper recording in the National Registry of Heraldic Devices and
shall transmit the approved design to the requesting party.
6. Effectivitv -This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
